seoTitle: Kilroe House, Kilroe, Corrandulla, Co. Galway, H91AW2Y
description:
O’Donnellan & Joyce are delighted to bring to the market this imposing detached residence in Kilroe, which enjoys a peaceful rural setting in the wider Corrandulla area of County Galway.

Standing on an impressive site of approx. 0.75 acre, the established grounds have a variety of mature trees including beech, oak, ash, horse chestnut, walnut, sycamore and a large sequoia specimen.

The front boundary wall of the property dates from 1840 and was part of the Alcorn Estate that owned Kilroe Mill, which is still in existence in Annaghdown.

Reclaimed period entrance pillars and gates enhance the original limestone boundary wall and open to a sweeping driveway to the front of the residence.

Behind its attractive façade lies a very welcoming entrance hall with oak panelled doors and solid oak staircase that was handmade by a local joinery specialist in the Gothic style.

The living room/family room has a feature Inglenook fireplace with wood pellet stove enclosed by 200-year-old reclaimed pitch pine beams, which revive the original purpose of the Inglenook to be a warm inviting hub for the home.

At the heart of the home is a generous modern kitchen/breakfast room positioned to enjoy an outlook over the rear garden.  Providing ample storage and preparation space with plenty of natural light, the kitchen can be access thru the rear hall with laundry room and guest toilet.  A separate formal dining room offers access to the living room / family room and out to the garden.

On the other side of the entrance hall, a separate sitting room with modern fireplace could function as a study or office, perfect for remote working.  At the end of the hallway, a ground floor bedroom with a separate full bathroom is very conveniently situated for overnight guests.

A major feature of Kilroe House are the cathedral ceilings to the corridor and rooms on the first floor.  These ceilings certainly give a sense of space and light to the house.

The sleeping on the first floor comprises of a further four well-proportioned bedrooms, with the master bedroom with shower ensuite.  Another full bathroom and a separate shower room along the landing are perfect for a busy household.  A smaller room which could be used as a study or office, or extra bedroom completes the accommodation.

OUTSIDE 

There are three patio areas to the rear and side of the house, perfect for entertaining and catching the morning and evening sun.  A spacious detached block-built garage is a valuable addition to the property.  

Kilroe House has the enviable combination of generous private gardens and outdoor space that can be difficult to find in an urban environment.  Perfect for Galway commuters looking for a country home.
